why: main-thread-scheduling.md step 1 (G1): every ObservationStream evaluation runs as a visible task of the app's one MainFrameBudget. ObservationStream is a plain Sendable value of the system Observations call shape, made at about 400 call sites with no handle to inject through, and it lives in CmuxNextCompat below the scheduler's package; the one process-wide hook (ObservationSite.evaluations, main-actor, a protocol existential, set once by MainWorkScheduler.app at the composition root) is the seam. A @TaskLocal would miss evaluations made from AppKit callbacks, detached tasks and the system Observations closure. Removed when ObservationStream gets its scheduler by injection (R-SWIFT-MIRRORS windows replace the stream sites).
